address: 3663 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

zones.label: VIP Center
zones.description: VIP Center is the Sweet Spot: straight-on sightlines for the mind-reading demonstrations and a close view of Gerry McCambridge.

zones.label: VIP Side
zones.description: VIP Side keeps you close to the stage with a more angled view into the room.

zones.label: General Rear Center
zones.description: General Rear Center gives you a centered view at the value tier, useful in a compact room where the stage still reads clearly.

zones.label: General Rear Side
zones.description: General Rear Side is the budget-focused option with a wider angle across the stage.

zones.label: Balcony
zones.description: The small balcony sits farthest back and gives you an elevated overview of the room.
